forecast.method: log-linear trend + festive-season (Oct-Dec) dummy, least squares

insights.title: Revenue concentration
insights.body: Electronics brings in 48.4% of fulfilled revenue; the top two categories (Electronics, Home & Kitchen) account for 64.0%.

insights.title: Geography
insights.body: India generates 62.1% of revenue, followed by USA (14.1%).

insights.title: Growth and seasonality
insights.body: Revenue grew 27% year on year, and Oct-Dec 2025 alone produced 34% of 2025 revenue. The fitted festive-season uplift is 34.3%.

insights.title: Payments
insights.body: UPI is the most used method (38.2% of fulfilled orders).

insights.title: Forecast reliability
insights.body: Hold-out MAPE is 1.98% on the last 3 known months. The model is intentionally small (24 data points); treat the band as indicative.

insights.title: Finding the labels did not contain
insights.body: 9,592 clean orders (3.9%) are dated before the customer's signup date. This was not an injected defect: the generator does not link orders to signups. It is reported as an advisory flag, not rejected, because it needs a business decision.

insights.title: Anomaly scan
insights.body: 4 day(s) exceeded |z| > 3.5 against a 28-day rolling median.
